headline: Bajrang Bothra files substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Code for EPACK Durable
sum: Bajrang Bothra has filed a Regulation 31(4) disclosure with NSE detailing a substantial acquisition of shares in EPACK Durable Limited. The filing triggers mandatory takeover protocol under the SEBI (SAST) Regulations, 2011.
detail: Bajrang Bothra has filed the mandatory disclosure with the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. This disclosure is triggered when an acquirer has acquired or agreed to acquire shares such that the aggregate shareholding reaches or crosses 25% of voting capital, or when any person enters into an agreement to acquire control of the target company. The filing is the first public announcement of the acquisition and typically precedes either an open offer (if mandatory under Regulation 10) or a negotiated/exempted acquisition (if qualifying under Schedule III). No consideration amount, acquisition mode (negotiated vs. open offer), or exact shareholding percentage has been disclosed in the available filing text.
